name: AdAttributionKit (iOS 17.4)
plain: Apple's successor to SKAdNetwork that also covers re-engagement and alternative app stores.
meaning: A privacy-preserving way for ad networks to measure installs, reopens and re-downloads. Compatible with SKAN postbacks, adds marketplaces beyond the App Store.

android.note: No platform equivalent after Privacy Sandbox Attribution Reporting was retired.

ios.note: Postbacks reach the ad network; a developer can configure a copy of postbacks (docs); country code and configurable windows came in 18.4.

limits.headline: Can tell an ad network an ad led to an install, on iPhone, with delays
limits.user_action: You tap an ad, then install or reopen the app
can: Tell the ad network an ad led to an install, reopen or re-download
Send a copy of the report to the developer, if set up
Add the country code and set up windows from iOS 18.4
cannot: Give your name or device ID
Report right away or in detail; reports are delayed and coarse
Work on Android; the Android version was retired
limits.differs: iPhone only (iOS 17.4 and later). Android's matching system was retired.

story.what_it_is: Apple's newer privacy friendly ad measurement system, replacing SKAdNetwork.

marketing.name: AdAttributionKit
marketing.pitch: Measure ad conversions, with user privacy built in and support for alternative marketplaces.

story.for_you: You see nothing. Apple sends delayed, noisy reports to advertisers that an ad led to an install, without sharing your name or device ID.
story.for_makers: It tells ad networks which campaign worked while hiding which person did it. It adds re-downloads, re-engagement and alternative app marketplaces, and works alongside SKAN postbacks.

use_cases.example: An ad network checks that a campaign drove 200 installs and gets the answer three days later.
A studio sees which of its ads bring paying players, using a coarse value after the first day.
A retailer measures how many app installs came from a short video ad.
In the EU an alternative app store uses the same kit to measure installs from ads.
A marketing team compares results across ad networks in one report.
Signed reports stop fake networks from claiming credit for installs they did not drive.

story.android_note: Google's matching Privacy Sandbox attribution plan was retired in October 2025.
story.ios_note: Added in iOS 17.4 and compatible with SKAN postbacks.

history.change: AdAttributionKit launched with the DMA marketplace changes
Developer postback copy and enhanced configuration
Overlapping re-engagement windows, configurable attribution windows and cooldown, country code in postbacks
